merged.title: fix(rac1): cover widescreen with Visibomb signal-loss static
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
## Problem
T-24 reports that RAC1's Visibomb signal-loss static leaves uncovered strips at the sides of a widescreen view. The effect is a grid of textured 32-pixel tiles, so the renderer preserves each tile's original picture placement instead of treating the grid as a full-screen effect.

## Change
Wrap only DrawTiledScreenOverlay with the existing whole-target display-list markers. Keep the original game's draw, opacity, texture and timing, and restore ordinary HUD placement after it. Register the wrapper for NTSC-U, PAL v2.00, PAL v1.00 and NTSC-J using the existing release mappings.

## Validation
- Reproduced the same uncovered side bands in an isolated NTSC-U Novalis session at 1280x800: unlock weapons, equip Visibomb (13), fire, then let the missile leave its permitted area. No personal saves or mods used.
- Verified the corrected develop-based executable covers both sides at 1280x800; checked the same scenario at 1024x768 (4:3).
- Built `openrac-rac1-ntsc` with clang-cl on Win

merged.title: fix(port): stabilize FSR scenery motion and cap enhanced render scale
merged.author: pezzadev
merged.untrustedBody:
Distant static scenery could receive false motion vectors even with a stationary camera because depth reconstruction made a float world-space round trip. Compose clip-to-clip reprojection in double precision instead, sharing one camera inversion per frame. Moved ties and shrubs now enter temporal history with the interpolated transforms actually drawn.

Enhanced rendering also caps its effective render scale at 100% while retaining the saved preference; the settings guide documents this intentional behavior. The three fixes remain separate commits.

Validation:
- Built the RAC1 NTSC enhanced game on Windows.
- Four focused CTests passed: frontend_geometry, fsr3_frame, fsr3_motion and motion_blur, with Vulkan validation enabled for GPU tests.
- The distant stationary-camera GPU regression failed before the precision fix and passed afterward. Camera jitter cancellation, signed object velocities and full-frame FSR/HUD behavior remain covered.
- The motion regression also passed on desktop

merged.title: fix: guard every disc's tables against version drift
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** each disc's program (rac1 PAL, PAL v1, NTSC-J, NTSC-U; rac2 v1.01, v2.00, PAL) could bind a function, a C type or a data address differently from the others, and nothing caught it. Some carried rac2 and rac1 rows pointed at the wrong place (split variants, an L07 datum, PAL twins). Several features were on one disc only. The folders under port/game each had their own layout, and their READMEs were long.

**After:** parity.py checks bindings, C types and carried data addresses on every program, against both the release tables and versionmap's data moves. It runs in the build and in CI, needs no disc, and every deliberate difference has a written reason in parity.tsv. The wrong rows are fixed. The health HUD panel, enhanced Pokitaru/Fleet water, custom ship destinations and Aridia's counters now work on every rac1 disc. Every program folder has the same layout (tables/, release/, checks/), with a short README in plain English. The rac2 game facts moved to docs/port/RAC2_NOTES

merged.title: fix(renderer): remove texture pack stutters
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
Texture packs (PNG and KTX2) caused huge hitches in play, even with a few pictures.

**Before:** each time a HUD texture was converted again, the pack file was read and decoded again (130-550 ms per picture). Glyph pages also built a distance field at 4x size (~2.4 s). Level load decoded pack pictures one by one under a lock.

**After:** no hitch over 50 ms in play. Worst frame went from ~2.7 s to 25-31 ms. The title frame went from ~900 ms to ~55 ms, and Novalis loads in 1.6 s instead of 3.3 s. Nothing changes without a pack.

**How:**
- Pack pictures stay in memory after the first read (LRU, 1 GB desktop / 512 MB Android). Level pictures are not kept.
- Files are read off the lock. HUD pictures that are not ready yet load in the background, and the original shows meanwhile.
- A level's pack pictures are decoded on 8 threads while the level loads.
- A small per-game list in the cache folder remembers which pictures were shown in play, so later runs read only those ahead.
- No distance

merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** the title movie had no Press START. Pause did not open, because a level copy read its data at another level's address. Weapon fire was silent: the emitter volume came back as a float the callers read as int, so it was 0. Several levels' AI got 0 for headings and arrival checks. Insomniac's asm functions ran as stubs.

**After:** all of these behave like the original, on NTSC, PAL and v2.00.

**How:**
- The movie player hands each picture to the game, which draws Press START over it.
- hostgen refuses cross-level data reads, and the build fails on them.
- int hand overrides for the volume and level-mover functions, each with a TODO to drop it once the decomp agrees.
- The asm functions are hand C, proved against the disc translation, or reach rows.
- New build guards, needing no disc: one for reachable asm (rac1 and rac2), one for call results the callee never sets.

- A level's pack pictures are decoded on 8 threads while the level loads.
- A small per-game list in the cache folder remembers which pictures were shown in play, so later runs read only those ahead.

opened.title: fix(rac1): save real inventory during randomized NPC rewards
opened.author: llesieur99
opened.untrustedBody:
Helga can request an autosave before her update returns, while the randomizer temporarily presents the Swingshot ownership byte as the location's collection state. That temporary value can be saved alongside the randomized reward. Archipelago uses the same substitutions, and its existing explicit-serialization guard can resume them too early when save calls are nested.

Guard save preparation, autosave requests and explicit serialization for the complete outer save call in both mods. Nested calls share the guard; the NPC's collection view resumes only after saving finishes. Preserve real inventory, arguments and return values, and retain Archipelago's coordinate/gold serialization handling. Declare the hooks in both manifests and add regression coverage using the existing mock hosts, including a full NTSC randomizer load-test route.

Validation:
- New tests fail on the original randomizer and Archipelago implementations, then pass with the patch.
- Built both mod subdirectories on Wind
